name: proofmarks
description: Marks what reads like AI slop on your page, says why, and rewrites it with the agent you already use.

interface.shortDescription: Marks what reads like AI slop on your page and says why
interface.longDescription: Proofmarks marks what reads like AI slop on your page, says why, and rewrites it with the agent you already use. It runs on your machine, next to your site's development server, and shows proofreading marks on the real page. Ask your agent to set it up, open a page with ?proof=1, and send a mark to your agent for a rewrite. Accept writes the rewrite straight into your source file, and Undo puts it back.
defaultPrompt: Set up Proofmarks on this site.
